articles.headline: Company raises full-year revenue guidance after stronger-than-expected demand
articles.summary: Management increased its full-year revenue outlook and said customer demand exceeded its prior forecast.

articles.headline: Regulator rejects company's lead product application
articles.summary: The regulator declined approval and requested an additional clinical study before resubmission.

articles.headline: Company reports quarterly earnings above expectations
articles.summary: Quarterly revenue and earnings exceeded the published consensus estimates.

articles.headline: Company cuts full-year guidance after weaker forward orders
articles.summary: Management reduced its full-year outlook because its order pipeline weakened.

articles.headline: Company to participate in an industry conference next month
articles.summary: Executives will attend scheduled investor meetings during the conference.
